as_told.title: Nixon, Howard Hughes and the mafia set up the S Force to kill Castro
as_told.place_text: Las Vegas; Chicago; Fontainebleau Hotel, Florida

plain: Around 1960, Richard Nixon, later president, is said to have called the businessman Howard Hughes to arrange a plot to kill the Cuban leader Fidel Castro, which then ran through Hughes's aide Robert Maheu to the gangsters Johnny Roselli and Sam Giancana. A lawyer named Dan Sheehan tells it, saying it all came straight from Santo Trafficante Jr., a man he says was a client of the firm where he worked. Sheehan tells it on two episodes, and in one he adds more names, Sheffield Edwards and Paul Helliwell, a meeting at the Fontainebleau Hotel, and a unit he calls the S Force.
